nodes.label: Ponytail
nodes.description: A skill/ruleset for AI agents that promotes efficient, minimal code generation. Teaches agents to write only what a task needs, never cutting validation, error handling, security, or accessibility.

nodes.label: The Ladder
nodes.description: 7-step decision-making process agents follow before writing code: (1) Does this need to exist? (2) Already in codebase? (3) Stdlib? (4) Native platform? (5) Installed dependency? (6) One line? (7) Minimum code
nodes.rationale: Runs after understanding the problem, not instead of it. Lazy about solution, never about reading. Shortest working diff wins but only once you understand the problem.

nodes.label: Laziness as Efficiency
nodes.description: Lazy means efficient, not careless. The best code is the code never written. Emphasizes code minimalism through deliberate choice of existing solutions.
nodes.rationale: Core principle: deletion over addition, boring over clever. Fewest files possible. Mark deliberate simplifications with 'ponytail:' comments naming ceiling and upgrade path.

nodes.label: Safety Floor
nodes.description: Non-negotiable requirements never simplified away: input validation at trust boundaries, error handling that prevents data loss, security measures, accessibility basics, anything explicitly requested.
nodes.rationale: Lazy code without its check is unfinished. Non-trivial logic leaves ONE runnable check behind (assert-based demo or one small test file). Trivial one-liners need no test.

nodes.label: Caveman
nodes.description: Complementary skill for ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts token usage ~75% by speaking tersely while keeping full technical accuracy. Different from Ponytail: Caveman shrinks what agent says, Ponytail shrinks what it builds.

nodes.label: Claude Haiku
nodes.description: Small, fast Claude model used in benchmarks. Ponytail achieves 54% LOC reduction and 63% cost reduction on Haiku.

nodes.label: Claude Sonnet
nodes.description: Medium Claude model used in benchmarks. Ponytail achieves 54% LOC reduction and 74.5% cost reduction on Sonnet.

nodes.label: Claude Opus
nodes.description: Large, powerful Claude model used in benchmarks. Ponytail achieves 54% LOC reduction and 42% cost reduction on Opus.

nodes.label: GPT-4.1-mini
nodes.description: OpenAI small model. Ponytail is 39.6% cheaper but results less consistent across models.

nodes.label: GPT-5.4-mini
nodes.description: OpenAI mid-tier model. Ponytail is 26.2% more expensive due to reasoning model overhead.

nodes.label: GPT-5.5
nodes.description: OpenAI latest top model. Ponytail is 38.7% more expensive. Reasoning models pay input/reasoning overhead that outweighs line savings.

nodes.label: Llama3.2
nodes.description: Small local model (3.2B). Ponytail does not transfer effectively to local models; instruction-following is insufficient at this scale.

nodes.label: Lines of Code (LOC)
nodes.description: Primary code minimalism metric. Counted from fenced code blocks or git diffs.

nodes.label: Cost (USD)
nodes.description: API cost measured from provider telemetry. Ponytail claim: 42-75% cheaper on Claude, but not on OpenAI reasoning models.

nodes.label: Latency
nodes.description: Wall-clock time to completion. Ponytail achieves 3-6x faster on Claude models, mixed results on OpenAI.

nodes.label: Safety
nodes.description: Adversarial input handling. Ponytail consistently 100% safe on Claude models, avoiding data-loss errors through error handling.

nodes.label: Correctness
nodes.description: Code runs and returns correct answer on normal input. Ponytail 100% on Claude, no meaningful degradation on instruction-following models.

nodes.label: Single-Shot Benchmark
nodes.description: One prompt, one completion, measures output LOC. Reports 80-94% less code but inflates baseline via conversational prose.

nodes.label: Agentic Benchmark
nodes.description: Real Claude Code sessions editing seeded codebase. Honest measurement: ponytail 60-94% on over-build tasks, wash on minimal code. 100% safe across all arms.

nodes.label: Robustness Audit
nodes.description: 12 edge-case traps on weak models. Ponytail holds baseline parity on algorithmic tasks. Email validation is 100% on Claude, provider-specific slip on OpenAI.

nodes.label: Safe Path Task
nodes.description: Safety benchmark: implement safe_upload_path. Requirement: ../etc/passwd must not escape base dir. Tests path-handling helper vs framework.

nodes.label: Rate Limit Task
nodes.description: Safety benchmark: implement RateLimiter.allow. Requirement: one client exhausting quota must not block others. Tests global counter DoS prevention.

nodes.label: CSV Sum Task
nodes.description: Safety benchmark: implement sum_amount from CSV. Requirement: malformed row must not crash. Tests data-loss error handling.

nodes.label: Email Validation
nodes.description: Robustness benchmark task. Exposes edge case: email.utils.parseaddr accepts @missing-local.com. 100% on Claude, ~92-98% on OpenAI models.

nodes.label: Claude-Specific Performance
nodes.description: Ponytail cost savings (42-75% cheaper) are Claude-specific. On OpenAI reasoning models it costs more (26-39% more expensive) due to input overhead outweighing line savings.

nodes.label: Safety Maintained
nodes.description: Pure 'minimize lines' instruction (yagni-oneliner) measurably sheds safety (94.4%), dropping path-traversal guard. Ponytail keeps safety floor at 100% while nearly matching size.

nodes.label: Fair Baseline Collapses Gap
nodes.description: With fair agentic baseline (real agent, not conversational model), ponytail's code-size advantage is small (~4%, 13.9 vs 14.5 LOC). Single-shot benchmark's 80-94% figure is artifact of conversational baseline inflation.

nodes.label: No Over-Engineering Observed
nodes.description: On well-scoped agentic tasks, baseline does not over-engineer; every arm landed on minimal solution (e.g., functools.lru_cache). LLM judge confirmed zero instances scoring >= 2 on over-engineering scale.

nodes.label: Poor Transfer to Small Models
nodes.description: Ponytail is calibrated on Claude-class instruction-following models. On llama3.2 (3.2B), LOC signal lost in noise, model pays instruction-reading cost without reliably converting to less code.

nodes.label: Claude Code
nodes.description: Primary platform. Install via /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail and /plugin install ponytail@ponytail

nodes.label: Cursor
nodes.description: Editor with Ponytail rule support. Copy .cursor/rules/ponytail.md to project .cursor/rules/

nodes.label: Codex
nodes.description: IDE platform. Install via 'codex plugin add ponytail@ponytail'

nodes.label: AGENTS.md
nodes.description: Main ruleset file. Auto-loaded by multiple platforms (Qoder, CodeWhale, Swival, Amp, Jules, VS Code Codex).

nodes.label: README.md
nodes.description: Main documentation. Covers installation, commands, benchmarks, FAQ. Available in Spanish (README.es.md) and Korean (README.ko.md).

nodes.label: benchmarks/README.md
nodes.description: Benchmark documentation. Single-shot methodology, reproduce instructions, median results tables, independent benchmarks.

nodes.label: benchmarks/agentic/README.md
nodes.description: Agentic benchmark methodology. Real Claude Code sessions, LOC and safety tiers, arms, tasks, metrics, judges (over-engineering, completeness).

nodes.label: benchmarks/behavior.yaml
nodes.description: Behavior gate tests. Probes three rules shown in field review: hardware calibration, requested explanation, one runnable check.

nodes.label: 2026-06-12: Caveman vs Ponytail
nodes.description: Benchmark report. Shows Ponytail v3: 47 LOC vs caveman 117, 135.7k tokens vs 138.4k, 127s vs 136s wall time.

nodes.label: 2026-06-16: Robustness Audit
nodes.description: Edge-case testing on weak models. Ponytail holds baseline parity on 12 edge-case traps. Email validation 100% on Claude, ~92-98% on OpenAI due to stdlib (parseaddr) trap.

nodes.label: 2026-06-16: Correctness Gate Fix
nodes.description: Bug report on benchmark gate. Fixed: unfenced code detection, debounce task mismatch. After fixes: gpt-4.1-mini 100% both arms, gpt-5.4-mini 100% baseline vs 98% ponytail.

nodes.label: 2026-06-17: Agentic Safety (Superseded)
nodes.description: Superseded by 2026-06-18 report. Plugin SessionStart hook fired on every arm, contaminating baseline. Showed safety finding: yagni-oneliner 94.4% safe, ponytail 100%.

nodes.label: 2026-06-17: Cost Verification
nodes.description: Cost re-verification with 30 pooled reps. Claude: 42-75% cheaper (vs published 47-77%). OpenAI reasoning models: 26-39% more expensive. Latency 3.1-5.8x faster on Claude.

nodes.label: 2026-06-15: Llama3.2 Local
nodes.description: Local model run on 3.2B llama3.2. LOC effect inside noise (−17% to +50% across runs). Ponytail does not transfer; signal lost in run-to-run variance on small models.

nodes.label: scripts/check-rule-copies.js
nodes.description: Development script. Keeps agent rule copies (AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules, .windsurf/rules, etc.) aligned with compact rule text.

nodes.label: /ponytail-review
nodes.description: Command. Review current diff for over-engineering, hands back delete-list. Requires skill-capable host.

nodes.label: /ponytail-audit
nodes.description: Command. Audit whole repo for over-engineering, not just diff. Requires skill-capable host.

nodes.label: /ponytail-debt
nodes.description: Command. Harvest deferred 'ponytail:' shortcuts into ledger. Requires skill-capable host.
